judge.voice: Víte, I wanted only to ask Mia about school. The screen had buttons for help, good, but they went round and round. First it told me "Show me your drawing", not a school question. Then the phrase "I have a big garden" and the machine said this does not answer Mia! I was a little tired. In the end I used my own words, "You have school? I love you", and it said I should say "did". I do not know "did"; that is a teacher's word, not grandpa's word. I liked that it wrote exactly what I said, and "Tomatoes are red" I can use on Sunday. I did not try the replay. I would use it again, but only if help gave me one simple school question at once. The tutor's pace was slow and kind.
